events.title: 블랙번 로버스 are relegated to Division One just four years after being Premier League champions.
On- loan goalkeeper Jimmy Glass scored an injury-time winner for 칼라일 유나이티드 on the final day of the season to save their Football League status, and relegate Scarborough to the Conference .

선덜랜드's 2–1 win over 버밍엄 시티 on the final day of the Division One season has given them an English league record of 105 points this season. They will be joined in the elite next season by 브래드퍼드 시티, whose second-place finish has given them top flight football for the first time since 1922. 입스위치 타운, 버밍엄 시티, 왓퍼드 and 볼턴 원더러스 will contest the playoffs. Meanwhile, 맨체스터 유나이티드 go back on top of the Premier League with a 1–0 win at 미들즈브러.

아스널 lose their penultimate league game of the season 1–0 at 리즈 유나이티드, losing their chance to go top of the Premier League – meaning that a win for 맨체스터 유나이티드 against 블랙번 로버스 on Thursday will make it almost certain (regardless of final day results) that the league title will return to Old Trafford.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw by former assistant manager Brian Kidd's 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park – a result which confirms 블랙번 로버스's relegation (just four years after being champions) and allows the title destiny to remain firmly in United's hands.

맨체스터 유나이티드 clinch their fifth Premier League title in seven seasons after beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at home on the final day of the season, rendering 아스널's 1–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라 useless. Third placed 첼시 beat 더비 카운티 2–1, while 리즈 유나이티드 end David O'Leary's first season in management in fourth place with a 2–2 draw at Coventry. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's 4–0 home win over 미들즈브러 secures them a fifth-place finish and a place in the 1999–2000 UEFA Cup , their highest finish for 13 years and their first European campaign in 19 years. The last relegation place goes to 찰턴 애슬레틱, who lose 1–0 at home to 12th placed 셰필드 웬즈데이, while 사우샘프턴 confirm their survival with a 2–0 win over 에버턴.
리버풀 sign Finnish defender Sami Hyypiä from Dutch side 빌럼 II for £3 million.
맨체스터 유나이티드 wins the FA Cup with a 2–0 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 . The goals are scored by Teddy Sheringham and 폴 스콜스 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 complete a unique third 'double' of the league title and FA Cup with a 2–0 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 at Wembley. Teddy Sheringham opens the scoring in the 11th minute and 폴 스콜스 adds to United's tally in the 53rd minute. In four days' time, they will be competing in the European Cup final to challenge for a unique treble.

Two late goals (the equaliser from Teddy Sheringham and the winner from Ole Gunnar Solskjær) save 맨체스터 유나이티드 from the jaws of defeat and they beat 바이에른 뮌헨 2–1 in the Champions League final at the Camp Nou to complete a unique treble.

Two late goals save 맨체스터 시티 from the jaws of defeat as they pull 질링엄 back to 2–2 in the Division Two Play-off Final at Wembley . They go on to win 3–1 on penalties to attain their first promotion in ten years.

왓퍼드 seal promotion to the Premier League with a 2–0 win over 볼턴 원더러스 in the Division One playoff final at Wembley. They are first team since 노츠 카운티 in 1991 to reach the top flight with two successive promotions.
